info.description: REST v1. Browser cookie + CSRF; scoped Bearer tokens for integrations. Permissions and project boundaries enforced server-side. Optional integrations are disabled until configured. Maximum JSON: 5 MiB. Revision conflict: 409; fetch the current project before retrying.

calendar_versions.description: Optional immutable annual calendar IDs. calendar_id is authoritative for its year. Omitted on update preserves stored pins; explicit empty map clears extra years.

provisional_years.description: Derived years actually calculated using provisional Monday-Friday days.

calculation_state.description: Computed by server. ready confirms schedule and shared capacity; other states withhold active internal task dates.

external_reference.description: At most 500 UTF-8 bytes. Optional reference in an external system. No vendor-specific semantics or outbound request.

duration_days.description: 0 means capacity-derived duration. Positive values are a lower bound; insufficient availability extends duration without changing planned effort.

customer_email.description: One ASCII customer email address; empty disables recipient selection. Manager-editable.

week.description: Participation by weekday, 0 = Sunday. New participants require a schedule; missing legacy schedules remain drafts.

daily_minutes.description: Active days need a positive quota within the start/end window. Date exceptions replace weekly settings.

email.description: For local employees: administrator-supplied email. For external identities: read from the authoritative directory snapshot; submitted email is ignored.

serviceToken.description: Opaque random service token, constrained by scopes and project IDs at issuance. Not a JWT.
